column6: Fund finance facility mechanics — capital call advance rates 50-90%
column7: Industry-standard SLCF mechanics: advance rates 50-90% of eligible LP commitments (tier-based by investor quality). Single-investor concentration cap 10-25%. Minimum undrawn coverage 1.5-3.0x. Overcall rights 10-25%. Breach = mandatory prepayment. Pricing SOFR+135-275bps. CFG's $8.6B capital call book operates under these norms.
